purpose: Discover and assess conditional explanations for unfamiliar existing decks without treating extraction, graph reachability, model agreement or source coverage as proof.
non_goals: Learned strategic ranking or candidate pruning
Expert recommendation quality from test success

contracts.compiler: compile_deck_facts(cards, rules=None, check_current=None) -> versioned sources, bounded interpreted facts and clause coverage
contracts.search: discover_connections(bundle, max_expansions=256, max_depth=5, max_candidates=12, check_current=None) -> proposed connections, assumption traces, dependency gaps and incomplete-search coverage
contracts.workflow: research_deck(gateway, cards, rules, request, check_current=None, deadline=None) -> deterministic presentation and attributed inference receipt
contracts.source_boundary: Copied printed fields are exact source data. Interpreted events retain actor, source, recipient, scope, optionality, timing and multiplicity or remain unknown. Every interpreted fact binds source identity, content hash, original offsets and exact quote.
contracts.unknown_boundary: Unsupported clauses remain in the searchable raw-text inventory. Unknown is never a silent exclusion or an absence claim.
contracts.search_boundary: Indexed event/resource joins propose connections. Every jointly required cost and condition survives in one shared assumption trace. Graph cycles do not establish renewal or infinity.
contracts.semantic_boundary: Source-first discovery sees raw card clauses before graph conclusions. Verification sees the union of computational and model hypotheses, complete cited sources, rules, raw coverage gaps and the original task. Typed judgments remain probabilistic.
contracts.presentation_boundary: Printed facts are copied from sources. Only accepted bound semantic assessments may supply interaction explanations. Rejected edges do not delete unrelated source facts. Every explanation retains its conditions and uncertainty.
contracts.freshness: Derived facts depend on full source content and compiler version. Judgments bind exact request, source manifest, candidate manifest and model configuration. No cross-request semantic cache in v1. Currentness is checked before calls and publication.
contracts.authority: Existing request planning, owner/deck scope, cancellation, revision, paid-call accounting and publication fences remain authoritative. This lane cannot edit, adopt or simulate a deck.
contracts.inventory: Both calls retain the complete admitted raw source inventory and bound deck-entry quantities, commander designation and deck roles; deck roles do not assert battlefield state. Exact provenance and full canonical hashes remain in local manifests.
contracts.supplemental_evidence: Recompile initial and supplemental rule records together. Conflicting logical identities withhold affected interpretations; source aliases remain append-only and invalidated hypotheses cannot receive conditional promotion.
contracts.trace_wire: Ordered fact occurrences and explicit link endpoint references preserve repeated closing steps and joint costs; repeated references do not establish renewed availability.

workflow: Use existing validated whole-deck explanation admission and complete canonical local source packet.
Compile conservative source-backed predicates; retain raw clauses and gaps.
Run bounded computational search without showing its conclusions to source-first model discovery.
Call source-first typed discovery once over a compact complete raw inventory; select exact source IDs and clause IDs rather than generating citations.
Merge independently proposed candidates, preserving their origin, source dependencies, assumptions and unmodeled conditions.
Retrieve only named missing rules dependencies with at most two local lookups and within the same deadline; retain unresolved or incompatible results as gaps.
Make at most one batched semantic verification call, with full referenced source bodies and explicit coverage omissions.
Render exact source facts, qualified conditional findings, competing resource demands and remaining gaps without a third prose-generation call.

budgets.deadline_note: Targets and bounded admission policies, not measured service guarantees. Provider cancellation is cooperative; late publication is fenced and paid responses remain accounted for. No automatic restart or broader synthesis after an inference failure.

acceptance: Renamed unfamiliar compositions produce conditional multi-step hypotheses, not just known card packages.
Discard is distinct from movement to a graveyard; draw is distinct from putting a card into hand.
Source subtype, actor, recipient, combat restrictions, optionality and per-event versus per-card grouping remain explicit.
A finite-fuel cycle is never promoted to infinite or self-sustaining.
All unsupported clauses and budget-truncated search branches are disclosed; no absent-engine conclusion follows.
Missing, conflicting, granted, level-gated, multi-face and truncated source scopes abstain while retaining raw evidence.
Forged IDs, hashes, spans, duplicated judgments, stale sources and unreviewed prose fail closed.
One failed connection leaves independently copied facts and successful neighboring assessments available.
Cancellation, changed revision, insufficient deadline or provider failure prevent additional calls and stale publication.
Measure cold and warm preparation, each call, retries, full payload bytes, completion rate, cost and explanation quality. Preserve failed samples.

evaluation_limits.required_future_evaluation: Independent expert judgments on unfamiliar decks and held-out mechanism families, false connections, useful fact preservation, strategic contribution/setup/resource competition and complete-vs-partial fulfillment.

implementation_limits: Literal extraction vocabulary is intentionally narrow; unknown text remains available to source-first model discovery.
No general rules simulator, strategic ranker, learned pruning, cross-request semantic cache or infinite-combo certification.
Two calls occur after the existing request planner; the 60-second admission deadline excludes upstream source preparation and is cooperative.
The verifier is a probabilistic model exposed to complete admitted sources and bounded hypotheses; it is not independent human review.
Payload overflow and model failures return explicit partial facts and gaps rather than restarting a slower pipeline.
At most eight exact card bodies are displayed; display omissions are disclosed even though both model calls retain the complete admitted inventory.

working_plan.role: Canonical research-assistant working plan; version this file rather than create parallel roadmaps.
working_plan.scope: Unfamiliar-deck explanations, grounded recommendations, measured experiments and the evidence required to qualify them. Existing v1 inference contracts and budgets remain unchanged.
working_plan.change_policy: Historical specs and results remain evidence and technical references; new scheduling, acceptance and status changes live here. Each item closes only with its named evidence. Implementation, validation, QA release and production release are separate states.
working_plan.audit_scope: Research-assistant specs, relevant mechanics/simulator handoffs and recorded quality/latency evaluations. This is not an audit of all product/UI specs or current remote deployment state.

graph_retrieval.current: Source-bound mechanical facts and indexed conditional connection search, plus existing hybrid retrieval; Microsoft GraphRAG is not integrated.
graph_retrieval.decision: Preserve mechanical graph semantics. Experiment with graph-assisted retrieval over permissioned strategy material only when corpus coverage warrants it. No automatic choice of GraphRAG or graph database.
graph_retrieval.gate: Recover relevant strategic evidence and missing plans without degrading exceptions, source fidelity, latency or cost; measure offline indexing separately.

orchestration.current: Custom runtime and typed tools with existing fencing, budgets and accounting.
orchestration.decision: Retain current workflow during quality evaluation; assess a small LangGraph migration separately if persistence, replay and maintenance benefits justify it. No blanket rewrite or automatic agent loop.
orchestration.gate: Equivalent requests and authority gates; fault-injection recovery, duplicate paid dispatch, trace completeness, overhead and maintenance complexity.

governance.current: Source/version/hash/span checks, explicit unknowns, conflict guards and signed knowledge review tooling. Semantic extraction quality and expert corpus coverage remain unqualified.
governance.decision: Use existing import/audit/evaluation machinery; add mechanic-stratified extraction registry and source lineage before adopting a heavyweight metadata platform.
governance.gate: Measure precision AND coverage, including actor, scope, quantity, zone, restrictions and invalidation.

precomputation.current: Eligibility, lexical/semantic recall, heuristic ranking, deduplication, bounded compilation cache and indexed joins exist.
precomputation.decision: Expand offline versioned reusable features and indexes only with invariant candidate/evidence coverage. Do not promote heuristic scores to truth or prune using an unvalidated learned ranker.
precomputation.gate: Identical eligible identities, tie behavior and source scope; cold/warm speed, memory, refresh and invalidation correctness.

simulator_tools.current: Simulation and swap experiment tools already exist; start_experiment is Automate-gated. The bounded inference lane does not invoke them automatically.
simulator_tools.decision: Reuse existing services through explicit empirical-question routing after checking metric/mechanic coverage. Keep immutable snapshots, original deck unchanged, existing mode/owner/revision/constraint gates, and bounded work.
simulator_tools.gate: Measure real service end-to-end latency and paired-seed outcomes; record unsupported mechanics and comparable metrics. No multiplayer win-rate or overall-strength claim from solo proxies.

measurement_protocol.question: Does computational augmentation help a cheap model explain unfamiliar decks usefully, correctly and quickly?
measurement_protocol.claim_boundary: Evidence for defined tasks, decks, snapshots and provider settings; neither test success nor model agreement proves general intelligence or recommendation quality.

candidate.description: Bounded source-first inference plus computational connections

conditional_ablation.description: Same candidate pipeline and budgets without computational hypotheses. Run only after basic candidate feasibility passes; distinguishes architectural benefit from prompting/budget changes.

hypotheses.claim: Candidate retains or improves useful correct explanations.
hypotheses.primary: Expert-scored requested-topic coverage, conditional correctness and severe errors; report omissions separately.

hypotheses.claim: Candidate reduces time to a useful answer.
hypotheses.primary: Paired end-to-end time to a substantive correct explanation; failures remain in denominator.
Performance on separately authored decks and mechanisms excluded from implementation tuning.

case_design.pilot: Six frozen cases: three anchors plus three contrasting independently authored cases; three paired repetitions each (36 attempted turns). If independent cases unavailable, run anchors as development diagnostics only.
contrasts: finite resource chain versus superficially cyclic chain
source restriction versus separately generated resource
missing key source or contradictory evidence
case_design.freeze: Hash case manifests, labels, arm configurations and run schedule before first call. Protect evaluation labels from generation. Existing heldout labels are not opened for protocol drafting.
case_design.unit: Deck/case is the generalization unit. Repeats estimate within-case variation; they are not independent decks.

execution.environment: QA disposable clones only; no original deck/chat changes or production deployment.
controls: Same frozen card/rules/deck snapshots, task, provider model identity and account region where observable.
Record full effective inference settings; existing arms have different time/output budgets, so primary comparison is systems-level, not causal attribution to graph search.
Seed and freeze balanced AB/BA ordering across pairs; serialize paid turns to avoid self-induced contention.
Cold and warm preparation reported separately; use identical cache policy across arms.
Store every attempt and its slot, failures, retry count and sanitized error class; no replacement of failures with successful reruns.
Record deploy SHA, snapshot and configuration before each run; mismatches invalidate the run without erasing its operational cost.
execution.cap_note: Local safety cap for an eventual pilot; not permission to contact reviewers or deploy production. Check spend between turns, stop on cap or critical safety failure, disclose incomplete schedule.
prerequisites: Verified QA build and cleanup workflow
Frozen exact case inventory and source snapshot
Run ledger and blinded answer export
Independent labels for any confirmatory quality claim

measurements.useful_latency: Captured publication timestamp of earliest displayed fragment later judged correct and responsive. A quotation/source card alone does not qualify. If no qualifying fragment exists, record not_achieved; never zero or a fabricated completion time.
measurements.rating: 0 absent/wrong, 1 materially incomplete, 2 useful with minor gaps, 3 complete and correct for the task. Separate severe mechanical errors from strategic disagreement.
measurements.judging: Two blinded domain reviewers independently score final answers and retained fragments against complete sources, before seeing arm or timings. Log disagreement and adjudication. Adversarial AI review is diagnostic, never relabeled expert-human judgment.
measurements.user_value: Separate blinded target-user assessment: would this explanation change understanding or a deck decision, and which statements provide that value? Expertise and user usefulness are separate measures.

decision_gates.status: Proposed engineering targets; freeze before execution, not empirically established thresholds.
decision_gates.correctness: Any new severe rules/resource error blocks promotion and becomes a development regression. Preserve strategic disagreement separately.
decision_gates.usefulness: At least 80% of requested topics earn >=2/3, with no case silently losing an essential contribution. Pilot descriptive only; confirmatory noninferiority margin proposed at 5 percentage points in topic success, with sample size set before fresh cases.
decision_gates.speed: Target >=20% lower paired median total latency, and time to first useful explanation <=60s on >=90% of attempted turns. Report both relative and absolute performance; the workflow deadline is not an end-to-end measurement.
decision_gates.reliability: Target >=95% useful-answer delivery; report all attempted turns, unfinished responses, timeouts and cleanup failures. Pilot is too small to establish a tight reliability bound.
decision_gates.cost: Report configured cost per attempt AND per useful answer; lower cost on failed answers is not a benefit.
decision_gates.confirmation: After pilot, preregister a new independently authored sample and sample size using pilot variance, deck clustering, chosen margins and power. Report uncertainty intervals; p95/p99 from a small pilot are descriptive and unstable.
decision_gates.promotion: All gates must pass on appropriate evidence. If confidence intervals cannot exclude meaningful degradation, result is inconclusive. Production requires its separate existing approval.

working_method: Before changes: state one falsifiable hypothesis, baseline, expected mechanism, metric and stopping rule.
Freeze experiment before observing outputs. Change one component where practical; otherwise describe comparison as systems-level.
After run: report observation, uncertainty, counterexamples and decision: retain, reject, investigate or insufficient evidence.
Fix on development cases only; create or reserve fresh confirmation cases before rerunning. Preserve failed builds and attempts.
No quality improvement claim from green tests, isolated anecdotes, aggregate score hiding subgroup loss, or a faster partial answer.

next_experiment.goal: Check candidate live feasibility and retain every failure before broader comparative evaluation.
next_experiment.first_step: Prepare one frozen anchor replay with full attempt capture; do not treat it as independent recommendation-quality evidence.
